comment: Day and night cycle (DayNight.cs; GDD, 'Jour et nuit'): one day lasts `minutes` of each phase in turn (real minutes, paused with the game), the run starting at a random time of it (randomStart) or at the dawn. Each phase: name shown in the HUD, colour and intensity of the global light, night (evolutions and seals at night, the night's encounters); post-processing (PostEffects, postProcessing in meta.json): bloom intensity (bright lights and effects glow, threshold bloomThreshold), saturation and contrast (-100 to 100), exposure (EV), vignette (0 to 1), tint (colour filter). The light holds the phase's colour, then blends into the next one over its last `blend` seconds. clockStart: the hour shown at the start of the dawn (a day = 24 hours). devKeys: H adds a minute, Shift+H jumps to the next phase (devMode).
